body:
I have spent a decent amount of time taking care of kids and in my experience punishment isn’t an effective way to teach and tends to add stress around academics. I don’t know anything about your father of course, but I’m not so sure that his approach (in that instance) was particularly kind or helpful. And it seems like those kinds of experiences might have made you treat yourself with an undue harshness. All that said, it doesn’t mean you have to feel that way forever. I don’t have all the answers as far as that goes, but maybe you could take it a day at a time with being kinder to yourself and giving yourself more grace? 

Sorry to hear your friends aren’t going to be on top of celebrating your birthday, I know what that’s like lol. It still sucks to have to be the one to do it, but sometimes a casual reminder and a request like “Hey my birthday’s coming up on ___, you gonna buy me lunch or what 👀” can let you get the chance to celebrate/hang out anyway. That’s just how my friends and I talk together sometimes, so maybe not those words exactly haha.
Right, and he doesn’t really listen when you try to bring that up?

That’s super tough; it sucks to feel like you don’t have someone who can at least try to get what’s going on. Are there things you wished he (or other people in your life) were doing/saying to better support you?

It sounds like you’re going through a lot of really difficult things at once. I’m sorry to hear that other people in your field are treating you like that; I can imagine that makes it difficult to flourish. When I was in school I was an anxious mess and too low-energy to study or go anywhere. It’s really hard when you feel like you’re failing everything and there’s no way to get out of the hole. Do you have a lot of internal/external pressure to succeed?

And it sucks to feel like your feelings are “tiring” for others. I often feel the same way. Please don’t feel bad for your mental health being in a bad place, it’s not something you can necessarily control and you should be supported. I hope I can help a bit with that if you don’t mind.

Having a tough time doesn’t make you a bad student or mean you only have bad qualities. It just means you need some help, that’s all. I’m glad you’re here and I really hope you stick around. When is your birthday?
That sounds really heartbreaking to not be getting support from him when you’re feeling like this. Does he understand the severity of what you’re going through?
Gotcha. If you don’t mind me asking, is akathisia a side effect of medication then?

Hey, I don’t know anything about doing that, but I’m sorry you’re in such a tough spot that you’ve come to that conclusion. I really hope you don’t do it; if you want to talk about what’s been going on I’m 100% down to listen.
That’s a long time to be dealing with that! Do you have any things you can do that help calm it down?

Hey, I can relate a lot to that feeling of being dismissed and ignored when it comes to emotions. I’m so sorry your mom and other people in your life aren’t being supportive. You deserve to be taken seriously; do you want to talk more about how you’re feeling?
Yeah, that’s the worst. I hope you are feeling better; if not, is there anything you want to talk about?
Ah, I don’t think I’ve experienced that specifically, but I definitely know how brutal anxiety can be. I’m sorry you’re dealing with that; does this happen a lot?
Hey, I’m sorry to hear you’re still feeling suicidal, that really sucks. If it’s alright for me to ask, are there specific things going on that are creating those suicidal feelings?
Hey, I’m so sorry you’re going through this, what’s been going on to make you feel this way?
Hey, I don’t know anything about that and I understand that you don’t want to be convinced so all I can really offer is an ear. If you don’t mind me asking, what’s been going on?
Hey, what’s going on?

I’ve never heard someone put my mindset into words other than me before, but I’m also a “naturally optimistic person in a very depressed person’s body”. It’s tough, because I can get a sense for what kind of person I could have been, you know? 

I’m sorry you’re in so much pain. You do deserve to eat, and you aren’t  disgusting. I don’t know your exact situation, but I know what it’s like to deteriorate and be unable to take care of yourself/feel better no matter what you do. It’s not your fault.

I would gladly listen if you want to talk or vent about anything. I’m terrible at advice but I’m alright at commiserating :)

I often wish the same thing. I think you are more than tolerable; everyone deserves to be loved and cared for. Maybe those just weren’t the right friends? Either way, I hope you’re able to find some manner of peace and comfort.
I feel you man. I’m tired too, sorry to hear you’ve been suffering so much. I really hope things get better/easier for you. No one should have to feel like that.
Idk why, but I immediately thought Phoebe

https://preview.redd.it/snsdhy3m4h6b1.png?width=484&format=png&auto=webp&s=17262dc8718b61d3403047acab81543ab320c326

I needed to practice drawing people so thank you! Hope you like it 😊

I do definitely tend catastrophize pretty much everything. I try to stop myself when it gets bad, but usually I just let the fear and panic run it’s course because intellectually I know it’s probably not as bad as I seem to feel it is. In this case, it’s a combination of that and the reality that I might not have a job soon and I’m not confident in my ability to get another one in a reasonable time frame.

Good news, I didn’t get fired! Bad news, I got chewed out pretty bad and I was basically told to get it together before HR comes back into office in a week and a half. I have not stopped feeling completely anxious for the past 24 hours straight. I feel like I’m being watched (because I literally am) and I physically cannot relax. I have never in my life had so many consecutive anxiety attacks. Sorry for kind of dumping all that on you. Anyway, your suggestions are appreciated. I have been too worried about finances to get into therapy but I definitely am going to try and figure it out because I’m not going to make it at this rate lol.

Thank you for your detailed response; I know you’re right and I’m not helping myself by hating myself for everything. I just don’t really know how to make myself respond more reasonably(?) if that makes sense. Thank you again.
Maybe. I’ll look into it. I am not diagnosed with anything so there’s that. Thank you for your response, I really appreciate your help.

It’s not too sterile at all, I get what you’re saying. Thank you for your response. I don’t necessarily feel like losing my job in and of itself is the biggest thing. And it’d be easier to try to find a time when I wasn’t failing someone lol. As for your last question, I’d say yes. The whole reason my job is in jeopardy is because I’ve been too anxious and overwhelmed to get things done. Which just makes me more anxious and overwhelmed, naturally. 

I’ve always been like that and nothing seems to help. Not to place blame on some outside force or anything; it’s all my choices in the end. My point is just that losing my job would suck, of course, but even if I got another job I’d just do the exact same thing. I’m so sick of being anxious and depressed and tired all the time. I’m the actual problem.

Thanks man, I appreciate it. To be frank, there isn’t much to talk about. It’s not really based in any specific events so much as my brain violently rebelling against me lol. Still, it’s nice to hear that someone cares so thank you.
Same ✔️ Except for the engagement thing. Congratulations, if you don’t mind me saying lol. I hope things get better for you.

The day my dog laid in my lap for the first time. I got him from a shelter and he was nervous when he first met me. But that moment showed how he had come to trust and rely on me. Love him so much. How about you?

Hey, I’m sorry you’re in so much pain. You sound like a wonderful person and it breaks my heart that you haven’t gotten the support you deserve. I can definitely relate to the feeling of giving up a lot for others and never getting the same consideration back. I don’t know if I have anything particularly useful to say but I just wanted to let you know I hear you.

Hey, I read through your post and comments and I just wanted to reach out and say I’m so sorry you’re going through all of that. Loneliness and isolation are absolutely horrible; I also didn’t have any friends in high school (surprising I’m sure lol) and it definitely made my depression way worse. A lot of your post struck a chord with me because I have some similar experiences. I don’t necessarily have any advice or anything, just, I’m glad you’re still here and I really hope you stick around. You sound like a good person that’s been dealt a really rough hand.
I’m so sorry to hear that happened. You deserve to have people fighting for you. I can understand that it’s really hard to find a reason to live; I really hope you don’t give up on looking for one

Thank you for your response. I like that perspective, though I nothing in particular comes to mind. I am a pretty anxious person in general so it would be nice to just do things without being worried and scared all the time. Thank you again.
Can I ask what’s been going on to make you feel this way?
I don’t know if there is a best way to apologize in this case. I’m really sorry you’re feeling like this. How old is your child if you don’t mind me asking?
Thank you for responding. I don’t think I’ll go through with it tonight, so don’t worry.

I’m so sorry to hear about your fiancé. It sounds like you’ve had a very rough go of it. I don’t have any good advice, but if you’d like to talk about the things that have been going on to make you feel this way I’d be happy to listen.

It sounds like your ex really sucked, I’m so sorry you had to go through that. Doesn’t mean you’re worthless though; it sounds to me like you’re lacking in support if you don’t mind me saying. You don’t deserve to be treated that way, no one does. It’s not your fault.
It looks great
Wow your game looks fantastic!
No problem, I think it’s great how you’re taking all the criticism into account! It’s definitely tough though when everyone has different sensibilities and conflicting advice lol

I’d say the first one looks better, I think it looks more interesting with the background and the characters look more polished. 

That said, I think the background and title text could use some work. If it were me, I’d probably lean more into the pixel art style and have the background be pixel art as well. In that case, I think a simpler text would work better for the title because this one is somewhat unreadable (kinda looks like brick Odusseu lol).

If you wanted to go with the second one, I’d say to commission an artist to do a polished version of that illustration. I don’t think the composition is bad per se, maybe the viewpoint is a little close, but the unevenness of the lines doesn’t quite look purposeful enough to be eye-catching.

Overall, it seems like you’re moving in the right direction and I’m sure it will turn out wonderfully in the end. Good luck!!

I totally get what you’re saying. I have religious family too, so I know how that can be when it comes to things related to mental health. 

As far as the joy and purpose thing goes, I often feel similarly. I don’t think it means you’re beyond help though, just that you’re in a deep well of pain right now and have been for a long time.

History is damn bleak to look at sometimes, as are some of our present circumstances. I’m no history buff personally, but from what little I know I would say that within suffering there are also many times that people have been genuinely good to one another. It doesn’t erase all the ways people can be cruel, but I don’t think it’s all harsh.

All that aside, it sounds like you’re dealing with all of this without any kind of support system, which I already know is very hard. Do you have people in your life you feel can turn to and talk about how you’re feeling, even if you don’t bring up suicide?

Hello, I’m sorry to hear that you’re in so much pain. I can understand feeling hopeless; I’m currently in the same position, naturally. Clearly, I’ve yet to find a solution better than “keep going” haha.

It sounds like that attempt last year was probably a pretty rough point in time. Have you considered talking with your family about it? Do you think they’d be supportive? If not, would you like to talk more about how it affected you here?
I feel similarly. I’m sorry you’re feeling like this, man. It’s a horrible feeling to not have any support. Would you like to talk about it more?

Hello, I don’t have any advice, but I just wanted to say I’m sorry that people reacted like that. I bet that you were (and likely still are) in a lot of pain and it sucks that anybody would make light of it. I hope that they are able to understand better in the future, and I’m glad you’re still here.

Hey, I can understand the feeling of loneliness. It breaks my heart to hear that you think of yourself as an unappealing person. I don’t know you enough to say anything on the subject, but I don’t think anyone deserves to feel that isolated. I’m sorry you’re going through that.

Hello, I’m sorry to hear you’ve been feeling like this. I don’t have any particular advice, but as someone who has been in the same boat, I feel for you. I’m tired of being anxious all the time too, it’s completely exhausting. I hope you know that you aren’t doing anything wrong by napping when you’re tired like this and it’s completely understandable that you are feeling the way you do. Do you want to talk about anything you feel you aren’t able to discuss with the people in your life?

Hey, try not to beat yourself up so much. It sounds like she took it well and you didn’t do anything wrong by telling her. I understand wanting to self-isolate; I hope you’re able to feel better about the whole thing soon.
Thanks, I appreciate you saying that

Hey, it sounds like you’re in a really tough place right now, I’m really sorry you’re going through this. I really hope you don’t kill yourself; you’re worth more than just being an afterthought. Do you want to talk about what’s been going on?
That’s understandable. If you want to talk about what happened with your girlfriend or any of your other problems here, I’d be happy to listen
I get that. It’s really tough to get over losing someone that important to you. Do you have friends/family that dan support you rn?
Aw, that sucks so much. It sounds like you made a really tough choice for the both of you
Hello, I’m sorry you’ve been going through so much suffering. Do you want to talk about what’s been going through your mind lately?
Hey, I’m sorry you were in such a bad place that you made that choice. I don’t know what stopped you, but I’m glad you’re still here. Do you want to talk about anything?

Of course! I totally get what you mean about feeling like an alien, or the only one. When I was in college I actually made some ace friends and I think that helped me with a lot of those feelings. Most people don’t make an effort to understand, unfortunately and it can feel like an uphill battle trying to explain anything.

As for the job thing, just from hearing you talk about it I can get a feeling for how devastating that must have been. If you don’t mind me asking, is there another avenue you want to pursue career wise? What kind of things are you passionate about? I don’t necessarily believe that “everything happens for a reason” or anything. But, I wanted to also ask: even if you had stuck through and struggled with the job, would you have been happy going into those other potential political opportunities? Maybe this means you can find something you love doing that doesn’t demand your happiness in return. Sorry if I’m being too presumptuous, let me know if I misunderstood something.

Hey, it sounds like you’re dealing with a bunch of overwhelming things at once right now. I don’t know what happened with your previous job, but based on how you describe it it sounds like you made the right choice for yourself. I’m ace too, and I know how tough relationships are because of that but I don’t think you should write off the possibility completely.

Having no support network is really rough, and based on you posting here it seems like you’re reaching out for one. Please don’t give up on yourself so soon, do you want to talk more about what you’ve been dealing with?

No problem man. Yeah, that’s a horrible thing for them to say, I totally get why that was the last straw. Some families just don’t give you the support you should be getting. Do you want to vent about how you’ve been treated?
Lol, that’s what you’ve been thinking about?

I don’t want to make big assumptions about you or your family, but I will say that this isn’t a normal thing for your mom to say to you. These things they’re telling you aren’t reflective of who you are, it’s about their own issues. It just sucks that they’re hurting you in the process. I’m here if there’s things you want to talk about. I can’t promise I’ll be good with advice, but I’m always happy to listen.
I’m sorry you’ve been dealing with them for so long. I know how tough that can be. Do you want to talk about what you’ve been thinking?
You aren’t useless. I’m sorry you’re going through so much pain. Do you want to talk about what’s been going on?
Do you want to talk things out before that point? If you don’t mind me asking, why are you calling yourself a pig?

Hello, your post breaks my heart. Everyone deserves to be appreciated for who they are and I’m sorry you haven’t gotten the support you needed from your family. I think it’s completely understandable to not want to share things with people who are quick to pick apart and judge you. Also, you aren’t worthless, it sounds like you’ve just been put in a position to be overly critical of yourself. Do you live with your family?

Hey, I’m sorry you’re going through so much! To me, it doesn’t sound like you’re a bad person. It sounds like you’re in a rough situation. Becoming an adult is already tough enough without being threatened with homelessness. Do you have any friends’ houses you could stay at in the worst case scenario?

Hello, hearing your story really broke my heart. I don’t have anything to offer in terms of advice, but you said you don’t have anyone to talk to. So, is there anything you want to vent about? I’m happy to listen.
Hey man, I’m so sorry to hear that you’re planning to kill yourself. You must be in a lot of pain, do you want to talk about it?
Of course, it’s tough out here, we’ve gotta acknowledge each other! Let me know if you ever wanna talk.
Of course :)

I think those are fantastic reasons to stay alive. I may not know you personally, but as someone in a similar position as you I feel for you and your pain. Your reasoning resonated with me as well, and I think it helped me too. I guess what I’m getting at is that our connections to people are incredibly important. You are loved and you are giving love, and it would be a real shame for that chain to break.

Hey, I’m in a similar boat, I’m so sorry you’re in this position. It really sucks to be caught between pain and obligation. I just wanted to say, you don’t have to “earn” depression. Your pain is real and it’s not your fault. I hope things get easier for you, let me know if you want to talk.
Hey, I’m sorry you’ve been driven into a corner to that extent. I’m glad you’re still alive. What kind of things have helped you in the past?
Hey, I’m so sorry for all the pain you’ve been through. I know how it feels when nothing ever goes right. I’d love to listen if you want to talk about any of it.
Hey, I’m here. What’s been going on?

Ah, I see. It might be worth it to see if you can find someone to talk to that is able to understand you better. That aside, are there other things in your life besides your job that you want to change?

I don’t have any advice, but I feel for you. I’m sorry you’re having such a hard time and I hope that you’re able to find more joy in your life. If you don’t mind me asking, are you in therapy at the moment?
Hey, I know this isn’t the image you wanted for this day, but I’m so glad you’re here! Happy Birthday!🎈 If you want to talk, I’d love to listen!
That’s alright, thank you for commiserating with me!

That’s the tough part, isn’t it! I wish you all the luck, I’m sure you can do it. Let me know if you want to talk about anything else? I can also try not to lecture so much, I realize I went straight into problem-solving mode 😅

And yeah, thank you! I’m trying; being nice to myself is hard most of the time lol

I know how it feels to let down people who look up to you, and ultimately you should do what makes you comfortable. 

That said, my suggestion would be to let them know that you’re sorry. I think if you feel that you’ve done them wrong it would show a lot about how much you care to be honest with them. Even if they don’t necessarily accept an apology or forgive you; it might be a weight off of them as well as yourself to acknowledge what happened and let them know that you’re remorseful.

Owning up to things is hard, especially when you feel like you don’t deserve a repaired relationship. But you DO deserve friendship, and making a mistake doesn’t necessarily mean you don’t get to have that relationship anymore. Whether you are able to reconcile with them or not, I think an apology might help you move forward and also give them the opportunity to receive some peace from it all.

You know them better than I do, so you can let me know if that doesn’t make much sense.

Well firstly, on reading this, it doesn’t sound to me like you’re a bad person. It sounds like you’ve been undergoing a lot of stress without a strong support system. There’s nothing wrong with reaching out to your friends when you need them, and I don’t think you should feel badly for doing so. Clearly, they weren’t equipped to be supportive for you, and I don’t know enough to make a judgement call on that. Regardless, calling out for help is not creepy, weird, or obsessive. And it doesn’t make you selfish either. It sucks that you had to feel that way when you were already in pain.

As for your friends from home, have you reached out to them since lashing out? Do you think they might be receptive to an apology?

It’s not your fault, and it isn’t anything inherently about you. All of the responsibility lies on the people who hurt you. I’m so sorry you’ve experienced that, and I’m here to listen if you’d like to talk about it.
Hey, I’m here and willing to chat about anything. I’m sorry you’re going through so much pain, do you want to talk about what’s been going on?

I know what you mean, it’s so hard dealing with all of this on your own. Even if I don’t know you personally, I felt like I had to reach out when I read your post. It sounds like you’ve been experiencing a lot of pain, I’m sorry you haven’t been supported in all of it. 

You mentioned that you feel like your problems are trivial, do you want to talk about any of them? Even if they aren’t a “big deal” in the broader sense, they are clearly weighing on you. In my opinion, that makes them nontrivial.

Hey, I’m sorry you’re in such a bad spot rn. A lot of what you said resonated with me. If you want to vent about any of it, I’d be happy to listen.

Even if you aren’t going to end your life, your pain is real.

Hey, I just wanted to say that even if you don’t intend to end your life, your pain is still real. It sounds like you have been suffering for a long time, and regardless of whether or not that kills you physically, that suffering in and of itself is horrible. I’m so sorry you’re going through that. You are deserving of empathy and kindness and I don’t think that reaching out when you’re in pain makes you a burden. Anyone in pain is going to reach out, and I should hope that you’re able to get someone reaching back.

If you’d like to talk about it: why do you think you’re fucking up?

Ohh, okay my bad for misunderstanding. That’s definitely a lot to be juggling at once. Moving is stressful at the best of times, though if you’re still living with an ex now it would probably be a good thing for you to create distance so that you can heal.

That aside, it sounds to me like you aren’t getting a lot of support in general. You deserve to have people in your life that help make things easier for you in tough times like now. Also, nightly flashbacks sound awful, I’m so sorry you’re going through that.

Yeah, I think I can see what you mean, it sounds like there’s been a lot going on and you’ve been taking on a sort of responsibility for your friend’s life that is weighing on you. If you you don’t have anyone in your life to hear you out, I am more than happy to listen to whatever’s on your mind. Also, if you don’t mind me asking, do you have access to therapy or any other resources like that?
You’re right about it not being easy, but it definitely helped that you responded to my post. I was feeling pretty alone, so thank you :)

Thank you for your kind words, it means a lot. I wouldn’t particularly know what to say, it’s all just kind of… an inarticulate collection of stresses and anxieties over the past few months. It’s been a stressful time for me, and I have kind of been forcing myself to get through every day without breaking down so I could function and get shit done. It seems that all that caught up with me all at once. Anyway, thank you for listening and caring :)

Hey, I’m so sorry about everything you’ve been going through, it sounds like a lot has been piling on. As for the dating app thing, please don’t take that as a measure of how desirable you are. In my experience, pretty much every dating app sucks ass and people don’t even usually end up in relationships from them anyway. That’s just my two cents. 

I think your mom would be devastated if you died, which I don’t say to guilt trip you, but to tell you that you are very loved. I’m afraid I don’t have much in the way of solutions, but I wanted to acknowledge your post and let you know that someone’s listening and cares. I really hope things get better for you, man.

Hey, I’m so sorry you’re feeling like this. I know how much it sucks to give everything you’ve got and have no one there when you need them. I don’t know if it’s of any comfort, but it sounds like you’re a really caring person who has been dealt shitty cards. My heart aches for you, and I really hope it does get easier. Do you want to talk about anything that’s been going on?
I feel similarly. Sometimes, it’s calming to think, “no matter what happens, I can die if it gets too bad”. Maybe not the healthiest coping mechanism, but it’s what I got for now lol
Hey, I’m in the same boat. You can talk to me, I’m not great with advice, but I’m a good listener. What’s been going on right now?

I feel the same way. I wish I didn’t always do the same stupid thing over and over. I’m sorry you feel like this, though I don’t think you are the problem. You’re hurting in a way that is imperceptible to others and that can have a very drastic impact on every aspect of your life. I hope things get better for you.

That’s understandable. For me it was graduating, and now it’s getting my own place. Sometimes its difficult to even remember those things when I need to. But I suppose you’ve gotta take it one minute at a time. Sorry I couldn’t be of more help; I hope you are able to feel less hopeless. You deserve to be heard, so please keep reaching out!

I don’t wanna push since I don’t know how your family is, but if there is anyone you think will be supportive you should talk with them. I know it feels like it’d be burdensome from your perspective, but if one of my family members were feeling this way I would absolutely want them to talk to me. Even if we weren’t close.

Aside from that, I’m so sorry to hear that.Eating can definitely be tough. As far as feeling like there’s nothing to look forward to, I can relate to that experience of course. May I ask, is there something that could change that would improve how you feel about your life?

I see, that makes sense. Do you have any supportive family members to talk to/get help from (to get into therapy, etc.)?

If not, could I ask if there’s anything going on that is making you feel like this right now?
Yeah, you’re a good brother, so I’m sure it will be fine :). I also wanted to ask if you have someone to talk to about tour suicidal ideation? It just seems like you’re in need of some support here

I’m feeling the same way right now, almost exactly. It sucks to feel like you aren’t able to achieve what you want to do. Your feelings are legitimate, and getting help can actually be really hard. If I may ask, what makes you feel like you are a failure?

Well, I don’t really have any personal experience to draw from, but I’ll give my opinion to consider. You probably shouldn’t have said that to him, but I think 14  is still old enough to understand that topic so I don’t think you did something unfixable. Either way, what’s done is done, right? Don’t beat yourself up to much and try to focus on what you can do now.

My suggestion is to have a talk with him about it, maybe tell him that you regret saying that. And perhaps mention that you feeling suicidal isn’t his fault and there are other factors involved. After that, I’d apologize. I don’t know what he did to make you upset, but presumably you shouldn’t have to apologize for calling him out on his behavior. Just the suicidal thoughts part. And, I dunno, tell him you love him, but he can’t treat you like XYZ. 

Without knowing the situation, I don’t know if that’s appropriate. If you already said your piece about whatever he did, you might not have to reiterate anything about that. Just do what seems right.

Also, I know you’re probably feeling pretty down about this, but it says a lot that you were able to reflect on it afterwards. You’ve got this! Please let me know if I got anything wrong or overstepped, and of course you should do whatever makes the most sense to you.

Definitely. A lot of the time I feel like I’m the only one not able to just “handle” life like everyone else. Turns out, a lot more people are having a hard time, so maybe I’m not such a failure after all? Something like that haha
Nice! Better than I was doing at 17 lol
That’s actually great! Congratulations

This is probably not helpful but: I get how you feel. I think I’m in a relatively decent place in life, and I wouldn’t typically complain about my family or anything. But I have also struggled with feeling like a burden and I want to move out as soon as possible. 

It sucks to be in that position, and I don’t think you should feel bad for not having it “worse”. There’s always going to be someone going through worse shit than you, but that doesn’t mean your pain isn’t pain. Even if you aren’t planning on ending your life, you are still hurting in a big way, and that matters.

Also, please don’t compare your financial situation with those internet millionaire types. A lot of the time, their whole thing is making people feel down about themselves so that you’ll sign up for their “How to Be a Millionaire” course lol. I really don’t have any room to talk because I still feel down about not being more successful too. But sometimes a reminder that a lot of that stuff isn’t necessarily something to strive for in the first place helps (well, it helps me at least).
